note: D-915. OFF by default. When true, a loop instance whose ledger launch was made by the launch chain (a launch_chain launch_started ledger line for its purpose in mechanism_trace.jsonl) does not count toward the reaper's lead-silence trigger (no heartbeat for 90 minutes). It keeps its deadline termination, its spend cap and the usage trigger. Read at call time; a missing or unreadable file means false. Only the operator turns it on.
